piece_type: DTC TV ad (“FARXIGA DTC TV: 45 – Places You Want to Be v2”)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: VO: “If you have heart failure or chronic kidney disease, Farxiga can help you keep living life because there are places, you’d like to be.” | SUPER: “FARXIGA can help you keep living life by reducing the risk of cardiovascular death”
cases.context: CKD indication: reduce risk of sustained eGFR decline, ESKD, CV death, and HHF; HF indication: reduce risk of CV death, HHF, and urgent HF visit. Approvals based on composite endpoints.
cases.rationale: Misleadingly represents that Farxiga was approved on the single endpoint of reducing CV death; fails to communicate all components of the indications.
cases.check: Rule: when an indication is a composite of outcomes, flag claims that cite only one component (e.g., 'reduce risk of CV death') without the others.
